name: kiraku-bi-web
description: 喜らく単体 Beds24速報BI（Cloudflare Workers + R2 データ分離）

scripts.test: node test/worker.test.mjs && node test/scheduled.test.mjs && node test/biViewModel.test.mjs && node test/components.test.mjs && node test/app.test.mjs
scripts.r2:put:manifest: wrangler r2 object put kiraku-bi-data/latest/manifest.json --file public/data/manifest.json
scripts.r2:put:snapshot: wrangler r2 object put kiraku-bi-data/latest/bi_snapshot.json --file public/data/bi_snapshot.json
scripts.r2:put:all: wrangler r2 object put kiraku-bi-data/latest/manifest.json --file public/data/manifest.json && wrangler r2 object put kiraku-bi-data/latest/bi_snapshot.json --file public/data/bi_snapshot.json && wrangler r2 object put kiraku-bi-data/latest/bi_daily_timeseries.csv --file public/data/bi_daily_timeseries.csv && wrangler r2 object put kiraku-bi-data/latest/bi_monthly_kpi.csv --file public/data/bi_monthly_kpi.csv && wrangler r2 object put kiraku-bi-data/latest/bi_validation_status.json --file public/data/bi_validation_status.json && wrangler r2 object put kiraku-bi-data/latest/bi_exception_summary.json --file public/data/bi_exception_summary.json
